parameters.prompt: A character expression sheet for a cute claymation robot: the same round robot head shown eight times in a neat grid of four across and two down on a plain warm gray background. Each is a round warm orange ball head with a big dark round screen face and two small cream ear pods. On each screen, glowing white eyes, eyebrows and a glowing mouth show a different emotion: happy, excited, worried, sad, angry, surprised, suspicious with narrowed eyes, and smug. Smooth matte clay, soft studio lighting, no text, no labels.
parameters.negative_prompt: scary, creepy, horror, ugly, grotesque, realistic human face, human skin, nose, photorealistic person, text, letters, numbers, logo, brand mark, emblem, watermark, people, cropped, cut off, glossy chrome, blurry character
